title: Adjunct Instructor of Economics
industry: Economics, Economics and Social Sciences, General Economics (JEL A)
text:
Position Description    
The Department of Economics at the College of Charleston seeks an Adjunct Instructor of Economics to teach undergraduate economics courses, assess student learning, maintain accurate course records, hold appropriate office hours, and communicate effectively with students and department leadership. The successful candidate will demonstrate subject-matter expertise, a commitment to student-centered teaching, and the ability to use appropriate instructional technologies. A master’s degree in economics or a closely related field (including at least 18 graduate hours in economics or a closely related field) is required, and prior college-level teaching experience is preferred.
Applicants should submit a resume and copies of all relevant transcripts in electronic form using the College of Charleston’s online application system at https://jobs.cofc.edu. Questions concerning the position should be addressed to Dr. Chris Mothorpe, Professor and Chair, at mothorpeca@cofc.edu. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled.
